prompts: Warm, friendly acoustic underscore for an 83-second animated explainer video about a local business. Ukulele and light acoustic guitar picking, soft hand claps, muted felt piano, a little glockenspiel sparkle. Bright, optimistic, conversational and unhurried, around 100 bpm, steady and low-key so a voiceover sits clearly on top. Instrumental only. Gentle start, a light lift two thirds through, and a clean resolved ending on the final second.

Modern, minimal, upbeat lo-fi pop bed for a clean tech explainer: soft plucked synths, warm Rhodes chords, light brushed drums and finger snaps, round bass. Friendly and confident, around 96 bpm, sparse enough for a voiceover. Instrumental only. Builds slightly in the second half and ends on a clear resolved final chord.
